settings.language.name: English
chat.intro.title: Introducing Party Chat
chat.intro1.heading: About Party Chat
chat.intro1.text: Party Chat lets you talk with the friends in your room while you race.
chat.intro1.note: It is part of MKWMP: nothing to install, nothing to pay. Only players in the same room hear you.
chat.intro2.heading: Voice
chat.intro2.text: Your microphone is on while you are in a room. Mute yourself or anyone else at any time.
chat.intro2.note: Pick the microphone and the output in Settings, and test them there before a race.
chat.intro3.heading: Camera
chat.intro3.text: With a USB camera your friends can also see you. The camera stays off until you turn it on.
chat.intro3.note: Voice and camera go to the players of your room and are not recorded by the server.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome
setup.welcome.heading: MKWMP
setup.welcome.text: Race online with your friends on a community server. A few steps and you are on the track.
setup.consent.title: Before You Play Online
setup.consent.text: Online play has voice and camera chat with other players. It is for adults: please read the rules of the server and confirm your age. You can change this at any time in Settings.
